material_default:
Edge-aware downscaling of land-surface temperature
Land-surface temperature products are too coarse for street-level heat mapping.
Existing downscaling studies report a mean absolute error between 2.4 degC and 5.1 degC.
We propose a residual attention network that fuses thermal imagery with reflectance and building-height layers.
Figure 1 shows the network overview and the two attention blocks.
Table 1 reports the ablation at the 30 m block scale over 12 validation stations.
The proposed model reduces the mean absolute error to 3.7 degC on 12 validation stations.
The coefficient of determination reaches R2 = 0.86.
Performance degrades over water bodies, where only 3% of the training patches fall.
